annotations.title: Upload a spreadsheet as a DIYA-GL book

description: Answers the link to the DIY Accounting Submit page where the person uploads a spreadsheet, a package zip, a DIYA-GL zip or a DIYA-GL book as JSON, which is read in their browser and saved in their account as a new DIYA-GL book. Use this when the person wants to bring in records they keep in a spreadsheet. It does not change anything itself.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to keep the DIYA-GL book in that client's set
